prompt: In this gamut monorepo, I need a new `StatusBadge` component (a brand-new small pill, not wrapping an existing Gamut component) that shows one of three statuses: 'success', 'warning', or 'info', each with its own background and text color. Write it in TypeScript using Emotion, matching how the rest of this codebase defines styled components with multiple mutually-exclusive visual variants. Save it to ./outputs/StatusBadge.tsx.
assertions: Uses variant() from @codecademy/gamut-styles with a variants map keyed by status (success/warning/info), not manual if/else, switch, or ternary branching to pick a style object
The status prop's type is derived from the variant definition (e.g. via StyleProps<typeof theVariant> from @codecademy/variance) rather than a hand-written union disconnected from the variant() call
Colors used for each status are semantic ColorMode tokens (e.g. background-success/feedback-success, background-warning/feedback-warning) rather than raw hex literals
Does not wrap an existing Gamut component in styled() with raw CSS to achieve this — this is a new custom primitive, so styled.div/styled.span with variant() is expected, not a violation
